Fix: `ClientStateVar.create("name", default=)`. Signature verified against reflex 0.10.0 (`reflex/experimental/client_state.py:87` — `var_name, default, global_ref`), so the rewrite is runtime-safe. 2. **4× `Var.create()` class defaults** — `components/ui/select.py:153`, `scroll_area.py:73,122`, `autocomplete.py:422`. Fix: `Var.create(value=)`. Verified `Var.create(value, _var_data=None)` in reflex-base 0.10.0 — runtime-safe. None of these are event-handler calls, so #203's positional-handler concern doesn't apply to this set. 3. **7× `typer.Option(False, "--json"/"--verbose", …)`** — `scripts/linear_cli.py:156,179,213,219,246,286,292`. **A pure keyword rewrite is impossible here**: typer's `Option(default, *param_decls, …)` (verified 0.27.3) makes `default` positional-first and `param_decls` variadic-positional-only — `typer.Option(default=False, "--json")` is a SyntaxError and `typer.Option("--json", default=False)` raises TypeError. The behavior-preserving fix is typer's modern `Annotated` style: `as_json: Annotated[bool, typer.Option("--json", help=…)] = False` — the `False` becomes an assignment default, which FBT003 does not flag. (Alternative per #204: keep the `scripts/linear_cli.py` ignore, since the file is dev tooling.) **Suggested plan** 1. Rewrite the 23 sites in groups 1–2 with keyword args (mechanical, runtime-identical). 2. Convert the 7 typer options in `scripts/linear_cli.py` to `Annotated` style (adds `from typing import Annotated`). 3. Remove the now-dead FBT003 per-file-ignores in `.trunk/configs/ruff.toml` for `app/hooks.py`, `app/www/library/**`, and `scripts/linear_cli.py`; keep `components/** = ["FBT003"]` per #203 (Reflex handler calls there stay positional by design). 4. Verify: `ruff check --select FBT .` → 0 findings; `ruff check --config .trunk/configs/ruff.toml --select FBT .` → 0; `ruff format --diff` clean on touched files. One trade-off worth restating (from #204): all 47 `ClientStateVar.create` sites in the repo pass `default` positionally, so keyword-izing only the 19 boolean ones creates a bool-vs-rest split that CI then enforces on every new boolean var. The issue explicitly directs keyword args, so proceeding is the author's call.   ｜ [Implement a fix ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/elviskahoro/buridan-ui/290?action=build) ｜ [View workflow run](https://github.com/elviskahoro/buridan-ui/actions/runs/41953885274/job/127004021464) ｜ via [Pullfrog](https://pullfrog.com) ｜ Using `glm-5p3-flash` ｜ [𝕏](https://x.com/pullfrogai) --

content.text:
I fixed all 30 FBT003 findings from #290. I haven't committed or opened a PR.

- **Reflex sites (23):** each `ClientStateVar.create("name", <bool>)` call now passes `default=<bool>`. Each `Var.create(<bool>)` class default now passes `value=<bool>`. These are in `app/hooks.py`, `app/www/library/**` and `components/ui/{select,scroll_area,autocomplete}.py`.
- **Typer options (7):** the options in `scripts/linear_cli.py` now use the `Annotated[bool, typer.Option(...)] = False` style. A keyword rewrite isn't possible there, because typer takes the default positionally ahead of the flag names. I added `Annotated` to the typing import.
- **Ruff config:** I removed the FBT003 per-file ignores for `app/hooks.py`, `app/www/library/**` and `scripts/linear_cli.py` from `.trunk/configs/ruff.toml`. I kept the `components/**` ignore, as the issue plan says.
- **Formatting:** two of the rewritten calls (`app/hooks.py`, `select_align_items.py`) exceeded the line length, so I reformatted them.

**Checks:** `ruff check --select FBT .` reports 0 findings. `ruff check --config .trunk/configs/ruff.toml` passes on all touched files. `ruff format --check` also passes on them. I did not run the Reflex app or any tests. I also couldn't run the `scripts/linear_cli.py` command, because `typer` isn't installed in this sandbox.
